text:
camille: Quick check-in on the 'slimline' console query refactor. Follow-up from RFC: how are we prioritizing RBAC pushdown vs keeping authz-shim for short term? Need to lock plan for next sprint.
jord: My read: pushdown is cleaner long-term but will take ~3-4 sprints to finish for multi-tenant rules. Proposal: keep authz_shim + add per-route prefetch caches and a deprecation plan.
lee: Agree. Two concerns: 1) SLO impact when we add authz checks to fanout; 2) cache invalidation complexity when permissions change.
anya: For SLOs we could: route low-latency reads to shim cached path, and slow-path to pushdown. Would need a fast decision in gateway.
camille: Sketch of rollout: feature-flag pushdown per-tenant, canary on internal tenants -> metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, auth_errors, cache_miss_rate, cost_per_token? (jk) ; )
jord: Add trace-id tags for auth-path so perf dashboards can slice by auth path. Also: config snippet proposal:
```
authz:
  mode: hybrid
  fallback: shim
  tenant_flags:
    pushdown-enabled: true
  cache:
    ttl: 30s
```
lee: Question about invalidation TTL: 30s might be okay but for sensitive tenants we need near-immediate revocations. We should add 'forced-revocations' hook to console to flush caches on role changes.
anya: We have KMS webhook from IAM that could trigger flush. Ops needs an endpoint for 'flush-tenant-cache' — @infra-bot, can you add a small admin route?
infra-bot: infra-bot: created ticket INF-1284 for admin flush route, ETA 2d. Will add rate-limiting and auth.
camille: Nice. Also need to update rollout checklist: telemetry (dashboards + alerts), migration plan (db index for auth rules), and docs for SDKs. Who owns docs?
jord: I'll own migration index work. @anya can you do docs and rollout playbook?
anya: Yep, will draft PR with examples and migration steps. Will include curl snippet to toggle tenant flag.
lee: One more tradeoff: doing prefix KV caching at gateway reduces backend load but increases memory. We should prototype memory footprint.
camille: Action items: jord(index), anya(docs + playbook), infra-bot(flush endpoint), lee(prototype mem). Let's sync Friday 11am for cutover readiness. :thumbsup:
